hook: Two iPhones, one phone number, in iOS 27

beats.say: iOS 27 adds iPhone Handoff, which lets you keep the same phone number on two iPhones.
One phone is the main iPhone and the other is secondary. Unlock either one and the number becomes active on it, with a Switched to this iPhone banner.
The number is only active on one phone at a time, some carrier services are managed only on the main iPhone, and carrier support is limited for now.
